parameters.formTitle: Field Merge — attach CSV columns by key
parameters.formDescription: Upload a CSV keyed by Domain or Final Email with any extra columns. Every non-key column is stamped onto all rows of the target table sharing the key value. Additive only: no inserts, no deletes. Every CSV column must already exist on the table: a missing one refuses the run before any write (the scaffold or the Operator adds columns, never this door). Final Email merges are refused on *Domains* tables.

values.placeholder: appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX — from the Hub Clients table
optional, comma-separated CSV columns — empty = every non-key column

nodes.name: Companies?
nodes.notes: The split (ruled 2026-09-02): on Companies the CSV lands through Insert domains to Clayroots (open fields created, allowNew on); on People the update-only merge below keeps its own path and creates nothing.

nodes.name: Insert Domains
nodes.notes: The landing helper: column check, open fields, DNC, Clean Fields, upsert on Domain (Domain Source = CSV on create only, Tag on every row). Counters come back. TODO: push n8n/Insert-domains-to-Clayroots first, then paste its assigned id into workflowId.value here.
